title: US bank branch closures per year: typical vs 2020

source.name: Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond branch-banking research

notes: The Richmond Fed reports roughly 20,000 net branch closures across the ~15 years since the 2009 peak (an average close to 1,300/year), with closures spiking to more than 4,000 in 2020 alone as the pandemic accelerated existing digital-adoption trends.
